app.name: Deken
app.tagline: Desktop POS for shops and retail — sales, stock, and debts, for almost any storefront

lang.toggleAria: Switch interface language between Arabic and English

dashboard.intro: Overview of today's activity. Numbers below are placeholders until live sales data is connected.

summary.mockAriaSales: Sample value: one thousand two hundred forty dollars
summary.footnote: Figures shown are sample data for layout only.

alerts.emptyBody: Low stock and expiry reminders will appear here after inventory is connected.

toolbar.rateLabel: Demo rate: 1 USD = {{rate}} LBP (not live data)

entry.title: Scan or search
entry.hint: Focus stays here for fast entry. Press Enter or tap Add to put a line on the ticket.
entry.demoCodes: Try demo codes 123 (water) or 999 (bread). Any other code adds a custom line with zero price until pricing is linked.

cart.title: Current ticket
cart.emptyBody: Scan a barcode or type a SKU to add the first line. This area will list items, quantities, and line totals.

debt.title: Record as debt
debt.subtitle: Adds this ticket to a debtor’s balance (UI only — not saved yet). Pick someone who already owes you, or switch to new customer and type a name.

fields.noDebtorMatch: No match. Try another search or add a new customer.
fields.name: Customer name
fields.hint: Type a name you’ll recognize in the debt list. You can edit details when the customer module is ready.
fields.noteHint: Stored with this debt entry when the ledger is connected.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a customer name to continue.
errors.debtorRequired: Select a debtor from the list.

toast.recordedDebtDetailNote: Debt saved for {{name}} — note: «{{note}}» (demo — not persisted).

products.intro: Sample catalog rows for layout. Search filters the mock list; add, edit, and category filter stay disabled until the inventory module is wired.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, category, or SKU…
toolbar.filterDisabledTitle: Category filter will be available when the catalog is connected.

actions.addDisabledTitle: Creating products will open a form in a later release.
actions.editDisabledTitle: Editing SKUs will be available when the catalog API is ready.

empty.noResultsBody: Try another keyword or clear the search to see the full demo list.

pages.debtsHint: Customer debt ledger will be connected here.
pages.reportsHint: Charts and exports will be added later.
